title: 日本語の森 N2 — 条件表現と接続パターン (Conditional Expressions and Connective Patterns)
description: From 日本語の森. This N2 lesson compares the four conditional forms: と、ば、たら、なら — when to use each, what nuance each carries, and common mistakes. Also covers connective patterns 〜上で、〜際に、〜に伴って used to link clauses in formal writing and speech.
